name: Software team
description: How a software team talks: the questions it asks, the tensions it names, what it decides, and the work it takes on.

recordTypes.name: Question
recordTypes.description: Something the team asked and has to answer.

Question.interpretationHint: A question somebody puts to the team that needs an answer or a decision: "should we…?", "do we…?", "what if we…?". Not a rhetorical question, and not a question about the conversation itself.

asks.interpretationHint: The question, in a few words, as a question.

options.interpretationHint: The answers said out loud, separated by " / ". Empty when none were said.

status.interpretationHint: Exactly "open" or "answered". "answered" only when the conversation settles it.

recordTypes.name: Tension
recordTypes.description: Two things the team wants that pull against each other.

Tension.interpretationHint: A conflict somebody names between two goals, plans or constraints: one thing could delay, break or cost another. Not a bug report and not a task.

between.interpretationHint: The two things in tension, as "<one> vs <other>".

why.interpretationHint: Why they pull against each other, in one sentence.

raisedBy.interpretationHint: The speaker who named it, as the transcript names them.

Decision.interpretationHint: Something the speakers agree on or settle: "okay, X comes first", "let's go with Y", "we're doing Z". Not a proposal nobody agreed to.

what.interpretationHint: What was decided, in one short sentence.

when.interpretationHint: When it applies, as said ("this quarter"). Empty when not said.

recordTypes.name: Task
recordTypes.description: A piece of work somebody took on.

Task.interpretationHint: A piece of work the speakers say needs doing and is not done yet: "we need to…", "I'll…", "someone should…".

title.interpretationHint: The work, as a short imperative.

owner.interpretationHint: Who took it on, as the transcript names them. Empty when nobody did.

flows.name: Decide
flows.hint: How a question the team raised becomes a decision.

states.name: Discussed
states.hint: The team has talked it through.

states.name: Options
states.hint: The answers on the table are written down.

states.name: Decided
states.hint: Two people agreed on an answer.

flows.name: Build
flows.hint: How a task the team took on gets shipped.

states.name: Review
states.hint: Done, and waiting for a second pair of eyes.

states.name: Shipped
states.hint: Released, with a link to what shipped: whoever asks, and one more person, agree.
